evidence: Matches Wallet label, modifies wallet implementation files in src/wallet/, and changes transaction rebroadcast behavior.
rationale: Adds configuration to stop periodic rebroadcasts that leak wallet identity and transaction ownership to all connected peers. Citing the PR description, 'The way this is done (periodically send to everybody) could have bad implications for privacy', and users previously had no way to disable rebroadcasts without also disabling initial transaction broadcasting.
